# provider::docker::image_ref

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: function. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Builds a fully qualified image reference such as `docker.io/library/nginx:1.27@sha256:...` from its parts, validating each one. It is the inverse of `parse_image_ref`. `registry`, `tag` and `digest` may be empty or null; an empty registry means Docker Hub.

## Usage

```terraform
provider::docker::image_ref(registry string, repository string, tag string, digest string) string
```

## Parameters

| Position | Name | Type | Null allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `registry` | `string` | yes | Registry host, e.g. `ghcr.io` or `localhost:5000`. Empty or null for Docker Hub. |
| 2 | `repository` | `string` |  | Repository path, e.g. `org/app` or `nginx`. |
| 3 | `tag` | `string` | yes | Tag, e.g. `1.27`. Empty or null for none. |
| 4 | `digest` | `string` | yes | Digest, e.g. `sha256:...`. Empty or null for none. |

Returns `string`. Provider functions need Terraform >= 1.8.

## Example

```terraform
# Re-tag an image for a private mirror, keeping its repository path.
locals {
  src    = provider::docker::parse_image_ref("nginx:1.27")
  mirror = provider::docker::image_ref("registry.internal:5000", local.src.repository, local.src.tag, null)
  # mirror = "registry.internal:5000/library/nginx:1.27"

  pinned = provider::docker::image_ref("", "redis", "7", "sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
  # pinned = "docker.io/library/redis:7@sha256:0123..."
}

output "mirror" {
  value = local.mirror
}
```
